title: Dataset Collection and Fine-Tuning of NLLB for German--English Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper describes the curation of a high-quality parallel corpus from OPUS Books and the fine-tuning of Meta's NLLB-200 models for German--English translation. We detail a dataset extraction pipeline that filters 45k raw OPUS sentence pairs to 25k high-quality examples through encoding validation, length filtering, language identification, deduplication, and quality scoring. We present a reproducible fine-tuning methodology optimized for consumer GPUs using mixed precision, gradient accumulation, and gradient checkpointing. Our fine-tuned NLLB-600M model achieves statistically significant improvements (+3.4 BLEU, +2.6 chrF++, -3.2 TER) over the base model on literary and technical German-English translation. We demonstrate practical deployment by integrating the fine-tuned model into LinguaHaru, an existing open-source document translation system, achieving format-preserving translation across PDF and Office documents. translated_title: 面向德英翻译的NLLB数据集收集与微调
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了从OPUS Books中筛选高质量平行语料的过程，以及对Meta的NLLB-200模型进行德英翻译微调的工作。我们详细描述了一个数据集提取流程，通过编码验证、长度过滤、语言识别、去重和质量评分，将45k原始OPUS句子对过滤为25k高质量样本。我们提出了一种面向消费级GPU优化的可复现微调方法，采用混合精度、梯度累积和梯度检查点等技术。我们微调后的NLLB-600M模型在文学类和技术类德英翻译任务上相比基础模型取得了统计显著的提升（BLEU +3.4，chrF++ +2.6，TER -3.2）。我们通过将微调后的模型集成到现有的开源文档翻译系统LinguaHaru中，展示了实际部署能力，实现了对PDF和Office文档的保持原格式翻译。
tldr: 本文构建了高质量德英平行语料库并在消费级GPU上微调NLLB-600M模型，使文学与技术翻译质量获得显著提升（BLEU +3.4），并集成到开源文档翻译系统中实现了保持格式的实际部署。
en_tdlr: This paper curates a high-quality German-English parallel corpus and fine-tunes NLLB-600M on consumer GPUs, achieving statistically significant translation improvements (+3.4 BLEU) and demonstrating practical format-preserving deployment in an open-source document translation system.
